e: The bishop of Quelimane, Osório Citora Afonso, is shot dead by unidentified gunmen inside his official residence in Quelimane.
Cyclone Gezani makes landfall over Inhambane Province, leaving at least four people dead.
TotalEnergies restarts its LNG project in Cabo Delgado Province after a five-year suspension caused by the Battle of Palma.
At least 13 people are killed by floods mainly affecting Maputo.
